ksp.h: Next level performance to defy what’s possible.
ksp.t: Tackle workflows previously not possible on a laptop with an AMD Ryzen™ AI Max PRO processor.1 With up to 16 desktop-class CPU cores, discrete-like integrated graphics, and game-changing 128GB unified memory simultaneously 3D model and render.

Take previously desk bound workflows from the office to on-site with the thinnest ZBook ever. Assign up to 96GB RAM exclusively to the GPU to run graphics heavy projects on the go or work locally with LLMs—with ultra long battery life.3

Hardware AI accelerators deliver power to propel advanced workloads. Offload and run productivity tasks locally on up to 50 TOPS NPU while also tackling new and more demanding AI enhanced professional workflows.4

ksp.h: Part of the world's most sustainable PC portfolio.5
ksp.t: At HP, we care about the impact our products have on our people, communities, and planet. That’s why this device is EPEAT® Gold with Climate + and the outer box packaging is 100% sustainably sourced.7

overview.t: Unleash groundbreaking performance to take on complex AI workflows. Defy what’s possible on the go with a sleek, thin, battery efficient, AI PC mobile workstation. Simultaneously render and visualize graphic-intensive projects. Work with LLMs locally like never before. This is power redefined.

source: HP Asset Manager: HP ZBook Ultra G1a Chiron Source Messaging and eTail Copy V1

ksp.t: Up to an NVIDIA RTX PRO 2000 Blackwell GPU and up to an Intel Core Ultra 9 285H CPU with up to 13 TOPS NPU.
Up to 64 GB DDR5-5600 SODIMM memory and up to 8 TB storage.
Optional 16:10 HP DreamColor display (3840x2400, 500 nits, 120 Hz) or HP Sure View 5 privacy display.
Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4, optional 5G WWAN; 5MP + IR camera with Poly Camera Pro.

overview.t: Upgrade to professional ISV-certified performance at an affordable price. Pro-grade components deliver exceptional performance for generative AI, 3D modeling and conceptual design.

source: HP Asset Manager: HP ZBook X G1 Sales Transition Playbook (4576614)

features.h: HP Recommends Windows 11 Pro for business with Microsoft Copilot
features.t: Work anywhere without compromising on performance with Windows 11 and HP collaboration, security, and connectivity technology. Summarize and rewrite content, get relevant content recommendations, and stay organized with Microsoft Copilot.

Unleash power-efficient performance with the latest Intel Core Ultra 3-series. This CPU with up to Intel Arc Pro graphics and dedicated Copilot+ NPU unlocks new levels of performance for the next era of AI-enhanced software and greatly increases efficiency for productivity tasks.
Experience high-end visualization and seamlessly multi-task on your biggest projects, now with up to an NVIDIA RTX PRO™ 3000 Blackwell GPU certified for pro apps.
Power through projects now with 2x the memory gen-over-gen, up to 128GB RAM for fast, powerful performance.
Blitz through multiple tasks with up 8TB NVMe and OPAL storage options.
HP Smart Sense intelligently optimizes your PC’s thermal and power management based on your usage. Select full performance mode when completing demanding tasks to maximize performance.
Have confidence in what you see on screen with an optional HP DreamColor Display with 100% DCI-P3 color gamut and a 120Hz refresh rate you get smooth motion for high-speed videos.
The portability of your PC and the reliability of a fast connection determines where you can work. Get a fast and reliable connection in dense wireless environments with gigabit data rate Wi-Fi 7.

Look your best on video calls and save some power too. Manage your video controls for internal and external cameras with Poly Camera Pro. Now Auto Frame, Spotlight, Background Blur, and virtual backgrounds save power running on the NPU.
Manage and monitor your 96whr battery’s performance and condition and customize charging options with the easy-to-use Battery Manager in the myHP app.

Work confidently in public with HP Sure View 6 - screen privacy technology that’s activated with one keystroke. Sure View reduces visual light to make your screen unreadable when viewed from the side to keep your information private anywhere.

With the optional HP Go 5G cellular solution, enjoy seamless, out-of-the-box connectivity for effortless communication, collaboration, and creativity that utilizes the strongest stable connection available.
Collaborate with confidence with advanced features like AI Noise Reduction to suppress background noise for crisp, clear calls.
Work with confidence knowing your workstation is certified by leading software vendors to ensure peak performance even on complex projects.

HP Wolf Security for Business includes built-in, hardware-enforced, always-on protection designed for workstations. From BIOS to the browser, Wolf Security helps defend against modern threats while maintaining device availability.
Designed for ultimate durability, this ZBook undergoes rigorous MIL-STD 810H tests to help ensure this PC keeps rolling through your workday.
The HP Workforce Experience Platform (WXP) empowers IT teams with AI-powered insights and workflow automation, reducing digital friction to increase employee satisfaction.
Enjoy the flexibility of wired Internet connectivity with the RJ-45 port.

Dynamic Voice Leveling automatically enhances microphone gain to optimize voice clarity within 3-meters of the PC. AI Noise Reduction uses noise-filtering technology to enhance audio conferencing experience even while wearing a mask.

features.h: One touch powers the PC and logs you in.
features.t: Power up and log in with a single touch of the power key that combines the power button with an integrated fingerprint sensor enhancing both security and convenience.

features.h: Wake and lock with your presence
features.t: Lock your PC when you leave it and wake it when you approach with HP Auto Lock and Awake. An advanced proximity sensor detects your presence and triggers the camera and Windows Hello to confirm your identity and unlock your PC.

ksp.t: Seamlessly power through 3D modeling, video editing, and rendering. With up to an Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 3-Series CPU, up to an optional NVIDIA RTX PRO™ 3000 Blackwell GPU, and up to 128GB DDR5 memory, ZBook X keeps even demanding workflows running smoothly.

Power your ideas where work takes you. A portable design with advanced thermals keeps cool and quiet while all-day battery life and Wi-Fi 6 or 7, and optional 5G with HP Go connectivity help keep you productive on the move.

ksp.h: Unleash Local AI Power on HP ZBook X
ksp.t: Save time for your best work with local AI on ZBook X—a Copilot+ PC with up to 50 TOPS NPU. 3 And with an optional NVIDIA RTX PRO™ 3000 Blackwell GPU with AI TOPS4, this PC powers through advanced workflows so you can focus on ideas—not obstacles.

HP is innovating with purpose to drive impactful, lasting change. This device is ENERGY STAR® certified, EPEAT Gold registered and has attained EPEAT Climate+. Its cover and keycaps are crafted with 50% recycled aluminum and 50% recycled plastics.

overview.t: Work with generative AI to explore design concepts, or complete 3D modeling and conceptual designs—all on the go. Built to give pros the power they need at an exceptional value, the HP ZBook X delivers advanced AI performance, scalable high-end graphics and memory, and all-day battery life. 2

source: HP Asset Manager: Ice Cream HP ZBook X G2i Source Messaging eTail V2 FINALMess
